# thurston-geometries: source provenance

Authors: Rémi Coulon, Sabetta Matsumoto, Henry Segerman and Steve Trettel.

Source: https://github.com/henryseg/non-euclidean_VR/tree/5e382dc7bc1e785ba225761d10f6a9f480e48556

License: GPL-3.0-or-later.

Original hyperbolic GLSL point/vector operations, geodesic flow, ray mapping and an m125 face-identification set. m125 is not m004. The files are pieces of the upstream shader/scene assembly.

Each copied upstream file is preserved without editing. See ../sources.tsv for original paths, Git blob identities and sizes. Only selected files are present; dependency closure is not claimed. Execution and numerical acceptance: NOT_RUN.
